
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoniu142857/p/23431834" title="发布于 2026-10-25 14:58">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">洛谷-P14775 [ICPC 2024 Seoul R] String Rank 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="solution">Solution</h2>
<p>我们约定 <span class="math inline">\(S_i=w[s:]\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(S(t,i):=Q_t(S_i)\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(T(i):=Q_{|w|}(S_i)\)</span>（即 <span class="math inline">\(S_i\)</span> 所有子序列构成的集合）。</p>
<h3 id="1-转化问题">1. 转化问题</h3>
<p>手玩小样例。我们就考虑题面中的 <span class="math inline">\(w=\texttt{aaba},t=3\)</span>。</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
S(3,2) &amp;= \{\lambda, \texttt{a}, \texttt{b}, \texttt{ba}, \texttt{ab}, \texttt{aa}, \texttt{aba}\}\\
S(3,1) &amp;= \{\lambda, \texttt{a}, \texttt{b}, \texttt{ba}, \texttt{ab}, \texttt{aa}, \texttt{aba}, \texttt{aab}, \texttt{aaa}\}
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p><span class="math inline">\(S(3,1)\)</span> 比 <span class="math inline">\(S(3,2)\)</span> 多出了 <span class="math inline">\({\texttt{aab}},{\texttt{aaa}}\)</span> 两个子序列。这是为什么呢？</p>
<p>后缀 <span class="math inline">\(\texttt{aaba}\)</span> 可以看成在 <span class="math inline">\(\texttt{aba}\)</span> 前面加上一个 <span class="math inline">\(\texttt{a}\)</span>。因此，<span class="math inline">\(\texttt{aba}\)</span> 中的每个子序列在 <span class="math inline">\(\texttt{aaba}\)</span> 中仍然存在，而新出现的子序列必须用到最前面的 <span class="math inline">\(\texttt{a}\)</span>。正是这样的子序列起到了区分 <span class="math inline">\(S(3,2)\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(S(3,1)\)</span> 的作用。</p>
<p>从 <span class="math inline">\(S_{i+1}\)</span> 变成 <span class="math inline">\(S_i\)</span>，只是在前面添加了一个字符 <span class="math inline">\(w_i\)</span>。添加字符不会让原有子序列消失，因此</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[S(t,1)\supseteq\dots\supseteq S(t,n-1)\supseteq S(t,n)
\]</div><p></p><p>要使 <span class="math inline">\(S(t,\cdot)\)</span> 两两不等，当且仅当每一对相邻集合都不等。我们设 <span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span> 为使 <span class="math inline">\(S(t,i)\neq S(t,i+1)\)</span> 的最小 <span class="math inline">\(t\)</span> 值。等价地，<span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span> 是在 <span class="math inline">\(T(i)\)</span> 中出现但在 <span class="math inline">\(T(i+1)\)</span> 中不出现的最短子序列长度。答案即为 <span class="math inline">\(\max f_i\)</span>。</p>
<h3 id="2-计算-">2. 计算 <span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span></h3>
<p>我们首先考虑二分，但是发现不但至少多一只 <span class="math inline">\(\log\)</span> 而且 <code>check</code> 极其难写，于是放弃这种方法。</p>
<p>往 <span class="math inline">\(S_{i+1}\)</span> 前面加一个字符 <span class="math inline">\(w_i\)</span> 就可以得到下一个后缀 <span class="math inline">\(S_i\)</span>，这种嵌套关系启发我们从后往前扫。设当前扫到 <span class="math inline">\(w_i\)</span>。</p>
<p>分类讨论：</p>
<p><strong>情况一：如果 <span class="math inline">\(w_i\)</span> 这个字符第一次出现</strong></p>
<p>那么 <span class="math inline">\(f_i=1\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>情况二：<span class="math inline">\(w_i\)</span> 在位置 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 之后还会再次出现</strong><br>
设在 <span class="math inline">\(T(i)\)</span> 中出现但在 <span class="math inline">\(T(i+1)\)</span> 中不出现的最短子序列为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[s=w_iw_{p_2}w_{p_3}\dots w_{p_m}
\]</div><p></p><p>由前面的分析，<span class="math inline">\(p_1=i\)</span> 且 <span class="math inline">\(m \ge 2\)</span>。我们需要考虑，还需要满足什么条件才能使得 <span class="math inline">\(s\in T(i)\)</span> 且 <span class="math inline">\(s\notin T(i+1)\)</span>。</p>
<p>接下来考虑第二个字符的位置 <span class="math inline">\(p_2\)</span>。为了使 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span> 不出现在 <span class="math inline">\(T(i+1)\)</span> 中，不能让它从位置 <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{nxt}(i)\)</span> 或更靠右的同字符位置开始匹配。所以 <span class="math inline">\(p_2\in [i+1,\operatorname{nxt}(i)]\)</span>。</p>
<p>我们枚举 <span class="math inline">\(p_2\)</span>，<strong>同时使得子序列 <span class="math inline">\(w_{p_2}w_{p_3}\dots w_{p_m}\)</span> 必须最后一次出现，在 <span class="math inline">\(p_2\)</span> 后面不再出现</strong>。因此 <span class="math inline">\(m-1\ge f_{p_2}\)</span> 且可以取到 <span class="math inline">\(f_{p_2}\)</span>。</p>
<p>注：枚举子序列起点时要求该子序列首次/最后一次出现是一个常见的套路，这个额外的限制既不影响正确性又往往让题目更好做。</p>
<p>于是得到转移方程</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f_i=1+\min_{i&lt;j\le \operatorname{nxt}(i)}f_j
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="3-复杂度分析">3. 复杂度分析</h3>
<p>容易 <span class="math inline">\(O(n)\)</span> 求出 <span class="math inline">\(\operatorname{nxt}\)</span>。</p>
<p>对于每种字符，设它出现的位置依次为 <span class="math inline">\(x_1&lt;x_2&lt;\dots&lt;x_m\)</span>。计算转移时，内层循环的总计算量 <span class="math inline">\(x_m-x_1&lt;n\)</span>。</p>
<p>对每种字符分别计算，所有转移的总次数为 <span class="math inline">\(O(n|\Sigma|)\)</span>。因此时间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n|\Sigma|)\)</span>。</p>
<h2 id="code">Code</h2>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
#define rept(i,a,b) for(int i(a);i&lt;=b;++i)
#define pert(i,a,b) for(int i(a);i&gt;=b;--i)
using namespace std;
constexpr int N=3e6+5,INF=1e9;
string s;
int n,ans,f[N],p[N],l[26];
signed main(){
    cin&gt;&gt;s;
    n=s.size();
    fill(l,l+26,n);
    pert(i,n-1,0) p[i]=l[s[i]-'a'],l[s[i]-'a']=i;
    pert(i,n-1,0){
        if(p[i]==n) f[i]=1;
        else{
            f[i]=INF;
            rept(j,i+1,p[i]) f[i]=min(f[i],f[j]);
            ++f[i];
        }
        ans=max(ans,f[i]);
    }
    cout&lt;&lt;ans;
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
